$Comment: The second rung of Orrin's Vow: Void essence, found at the table and brought to him. The
tables find void in good gear (iron grade and up, the odds rising with the piece's level), so
this rung asks the player to feed the table something better than crude blades.
draw_void counts Void essence the tables hand over (STATION_OUTPUT, exact id, qualified to
'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so both tiers count); deliver_void is Order 2, an exact-id
hand-in to Orrin only (TurnInNpcId 'giver'). Requires carries an Enchanting level gate beside
the stations feature, one step on the questline's own level curve. Rewards sit in Claim:
Enchanting XP and a personal Enchanting boost token. The Chains entry files it as tier 2 of
orrins_vow. Retune the two Amounts together; the find rate is in the void table, not here.
Name: A_Thread_Of_Void
